rules: Headlines/Display: Instrument Serif (italic for emphasis, sentence case only).
Body/UI: Space Grotesk (weights 300-700, lowercase or sentence case).
NO ALL CAPS text anywhere. Not even in overlines or buttons.
Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for major headings.
Fluid scaling for headings (text-5xl to text-7xl for hero sections).
Lime Jelly (#E3FF00) used ONLY for primary CTAs and key highlights.
Dark sticky header uses Twilight Bliss (#083645) with backdrop-blur-xl.
Road Journey cards must use Twilight Bliss, Lime Jelly, Azure Cloud, Star of Life.
Never use pure black or pure white unless explicitly needed for contrast over images.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle, soft ambient shadows. Avoid heavy box shadows.
visual_enhancers.corners: Rounded corners (rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl) for cards and sections.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise or grain for an editorial magazine feel, avoiding flat solid vectors.
visual_enhancers.icons: No generic icons or blob shapes. No emojis (except in Road Journey node icons).

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous whitespace. Use p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32. Give elements breathing room to fit the editorial magazine aesthetic.
grids_and_layouts.containers: Bento grids with asymmetry for complex data (like Grant Categories).
grids_and_layouts.header: Dark sticky header. Twilight Bliss background with backdrop-blur-xl (e.g., bg-[#083645]/90). No transparent background.
grids_and_layouts.road_journey: Winding path, alternating left-right cards, dashed center line, 5 steps, hover lift effect. Do not use numbered step markers, use visual paths.

motion.interactions: Hover lift effects on cards (-translate-y-1, shadow-lg).
motion.transitions: Smooth transitions on specific properties (never 'transition: all').
motion.animations: Animated progress bar toward 10,000 target. Live pledge ticker rotating names continuously.

rules: Ensure sufficient contrast between background and text.
All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case.

images.description: People running on grassfield under blue skies, representing a diverse community.
Student working in a library, representing education grants.
Medical professional caring, representing people in crisis grants.
Hands holding a plant, representing environmental or community building grants.

components.header: Dark sticky header (Twilight Bliss + blur). Logo text formatting: 'one' white / 'dollar' Lime Jelly / 'dream.' dim white, using Space Grotesk 700.
components.hero: Magazine editorial style, bold typography. Email pledge form with live counter. Animated progress bar toward 10,000.
components.road_journey: SIGNATURE section. Winding path with a dashed center line. Alternating left-right cards for 5 steps. Use Twilight Bliss, Lime Jelly, Azure Cloud, Star of Life. Emoji node icons on the path.
components.grant_categories: Asymmetric bento grid layout displaying types of grants.
components.team: 6 members with colored initial circles instead of photos.
components.phases_timeline: Horizontal scroll timeline displaying phases of the project.
components.trust_strip: Dark bar at bottom/middle of page building trust.

instructions_to_main_agent: Write .jsx/.js files instead of .tsx where appropriate as the user requires .js files.
Build the UI utilizing standard HTML/Tailwind for the magazine layout, and Shadcn for interactive pieces (forms, accordion).
Do not use ALL CAPS anywhere, not even in labels or small text. Strictly enforce lowercase or sentence case.
Ensure header background is NOT fully transparent. Use bg-[#083645]/90 with backdrop-blur-xl.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, forms, and interactive elements.
Avoid generic blob shapes or dashboard-like widget cards. Stick to the editorial, sophisticated vibe.
Use react-fast-marquee or framer-motion for the live pledge ticker and phases horizontal scroll timeline.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Create a distinctive frontend that surprises and delights.
Do not apply 'transition: all' globally. Target specific properties to prevent breaking transforms.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Add micro-animations for hover states and transitions.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters where overlapping content requires depth.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
